// HCA_03: CAN ID 0x303 (standard, CAN FD), 24 bytes, sender XXX
//
// Decode pseudo-code generated by CanViewer from vw_meb.dbc.
// data[0] .. data[23] are the payload bytes; bit 0 is the least significant bit of a byte.
// Shifts and masks work on unsigned integers wide enough for the signal.

// RequestStatus: start bit 12, 4 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 15
RequestStatus_raw = data[1] >> 4
RequestStatus = RequestStatus_raw

// Power: start bit 16, 8 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.4, offset 0, range 0 .. 100 percent
Power_raw = data[2]
Power = Power_raw * 0.4

// Curvature: start bit 24, 15 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.0000067, offset 0, range 0 .. 0.219 Unit_rad/m
Curvature_raw = data[3] | ((data[4] & 0x7F) << 8)
Curvature = Curvature_raw * 0.0000067

// Curvature_VZ: start bit 39, 1 bit, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 1
Curvature_VZ_raw = data[4] >> 7
Curvature_VZ = Curvature_VZ_raw

// Unknown_01: start bit 53, 1 bit, Motorola, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 1
Unknown_01_raw = (data[6] >> 5) & 0x01
Unknown_01 = Unknown_01_raw

// Vibration: start bit 56, 1 bit, Motorola, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 1
Vibration_raw = data[7] & 0x01
Vibration = Vibration_raw

// HighSendRate: start bit 66, 1 bit, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 1
HighSendRate_raw = (data[8] >> 2) & 0x01
HighSendRate = HighSendRate_raw
